analysis.reasonEn: The downtrend continues with 3 consecutive days of decline (-5.7%). RSI is at 34.9, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram at -3.1159 continues to worsen. ADX at 27.2 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is significantly higher than +DI, showing downward pressure dominance. The 5-day low is $683.45 and the 20-day low is $683.45, failing to form a Higher Low. The 5-day high is $726.14 and the 20-day high is $762.86, forming a Lower High. The price is approaching the lower Bollinger Band at $688.96. The surge in volume (2.61x) reinforces the downward momentum.
